      • BookingFormPane

        public BookingFormPane(GarageSystem garage,
                       Booking existingBooking,

      • BookingFormPane

        public BookingFormPane(GarageSystem garage,
                       Booking existingBooking,
                       java.time.LocalDate initialDate,
                       Mechanic defaultMechanic,
                       java.lang.Integer defaultHour,
                       boolean dropIn)
        dropIn: the same form without Date & Time. The booking happens as the customer walks in, so the time is set by the service instead, and the description keeps the drop-in text rather than the service names — otherwise a drop-in cannot be told from an ordinary booking in the list.

      • BookingFormPane

        public BookingFormPane(GarageSystem garage,
                       Booking existingBooking,
                       java.time.LocalDate initialDate,
                       Mechanic defaultMechanic,
                       java.lang.Integer defaultHour,
                       boolean dropIn,
                       boolean forCopy)
        forCopy: a new booking that inherits details from an old one. It should neither lock the services nor count away the old one's time, because the new booking is a booking of its own.

      • getChosenPackages

      • getServicePackageNames

        public java.util.Map<java.lang.Integer,java.lang.String> getServicePackageNames()
        The package name for each service that came from a package, by service id. The first package that brings a service owns it, so a service shared by two packages is named once.
